verdict.rationale: The client side runs entirely on the user's own machine. The skills CLI runs keylessly from npm with no account, and it installs from any git host, including private repos, GitLab, Azure DevOps Server, direct URLs and local paths, so a team can keep its own skill sources off skills.sh. However, nothing shows the skills.sh registry, search or leaderboard service itself can be self-hosted. Missing for 10: self-hostable skills.sh directory/registry/leaderboard service, documented open-source license, self-hosting deployment docs.
